paper.title: Algorithm 677 (TOMS, Montefusco & Casciola 1989, MASUB scattered-data interpolation, self-check)

field: numerics (scattered-data interpolation of a rapidly varying surface, single precision)
stack: Fortran 77 (TOMS 677, MASUB package and its self-check PROGRAM MAIN)

claim.text: Self-check PROGRAM MAIN of TOMS 677 (first test program): the maximum and mean absolute errors ERMAX and ERMEAN that MMERR computes for the 10x10 reconstruction (IEX=1, TP=10) against the analytic Gaussian surface, compared with the built-in ANS2 = 0.6059994 and ANS1 = 0.06695094. Registered tolerance: relative 1e-5 on each value. The paper's own values were not read; the claim is the archive's built-in reference.

attempt: Measured locally, not yet a verdict. Two passes: pass 1 (gfortran -O2, the recorded build) gives ERMAX 0.6059995 and ERMEAN 0.06695094; pass 2 (clean directory, gfortran -O0 rebuild) gives ERMAX 0.6059992 and ERMEAN 0.06695094. Against the built-in 0.6059994 and 0.06695094, the differences are 1.7e-7 and 3.3e-7 (ERMAX) and 0 (ERMEAN), inside the registered rel 1e-5, so the values would be reproduced. Blocked because the queue entry records no code.archive sha256 (scout: 'sha256 not recorded'), and the build-only record and G2 need it. The archive downloaded here has sha256 d4d94e7a7ca6cf1980e3c05af74731cea35d00d62358ace806b134e4a8a4e64b. Resolver: scout (registers the hash in queue/montefusco1989-interp-677.json, per operator decision #61 on the same registration for other entries). Once it lands, re-record with recipe.sh and set the verdict to reproduced. Basis patched: the archive as shipped does not compile (four PROGRAM MAINs); the build uses two verbatim line ranges outside the authors' tree, and the build-only record (manifests pre, mid, post unchanged) holds.
